选择与表单

日期选择器 AsamDatePicker

通过输入框与弹层编辑日期或日期时间。

使用场景 ​

通过输入框与弹层编辑日期或日期时间。 未设置 valueFormat 时保持原生 Date 模型；需要字符串或时间戳时显式配置 valueFormat。format 控制展示，valueFormat 控制模型文本或时间戳。

原生默认模型 ​

未设置行为属性时由原生控件解析默认值。以下完整 SFC 对照显式 undefined、null 和空字符串；输出保留原始模型类型，不把清空值统一为 null。固定原生版本的非法输入诊断与兼容限制仍按原生处理。

原生默认模型

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<section class="native-values-example">
		<p class="example-paragraph">使用原生模型和默认值；日期/时间未传 valueFormat，选择后保持 Date。</p>
		<AsamDatePicker v-model="value" clearable @update:model-value="updates++" />
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="value = undefined"
			>显式 undefined</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="value = null">显式 null</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="value = ''"
			>显式空字符串</AsamButton
		>
		<output>{{ summary }}；更新次数 {{ updates }}</output>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerNativeValuesExample' });
const value = ref<AsamDateValue>();
const updates = ref(0);
const summary = computed(() =>
	value.value === undefined
		? 'undefined'
		: value.value instanceof Date
			? 'Date ' + value.value.toISOString()
			: JSON.stringify(value.value)
);
</script>

<style scoped>
.native-values-example {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

格式、清空与禁用 ​

模型初始为空；选择后显示当前值。disabled 由调用方切换，clear 的行为与 update:modelValue 分开。

格式、清空与禁用

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="value"
			v-bind="{ 'value-format': 'YYYY-MM-DD', clearable: true, 'aria-label': '选择时间' }"
			:disabled="disabled"
		/>
		<AsamButton type="default" @click="disabled = !disabled"> 切换禁用 </AsamButton>
		<output>模型：{{ value }}；禁用：{{ disabled }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerBasicExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamDatePicker, AsamButton } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const value = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const disabled = ref(false);
</script>

</style>

范围与约束 ​

type=daterange 保存两端日期，disabledDate 限制不可选日期。calendar-change 表示范围选择过程；最终模型由 update:modelValue 更新。

范围与约束

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="range"
			v-bind="{ type: 'daterange', 'value-format': 'YYYY-MM-DD' }"
			:disabled-date="disabledDate"
		/>
		<output>范围：{{ range }}</output>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerRangeExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const range = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
function disabledDate(value: Date) {
	return value.getFullYear() < 2025;
}
</script>

<style scoped>

	gap: var(--asam-space-md, 16px);

日期单元格插槽 ​

default 插槽直接收到 DateCell，isCurrent 表示当前日期。导航插槽可以替换上月/下月和上年/下年图标。

日期单元格插槽

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<div class="example">
		<AsamDatePicker v-model="value" value-format="YYYY-MM-DD">
			<template #default="cell">
				<span :class="{ current: cell.isCurrent }">
					{{ cell.text }}
				</span>
			</template>
			<template #prev-month> ‹ </template>
			<template #next-month> › </template>
			<template #prev-year> « </template>
			<template #next-year> » </template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerCellsExample' });

月份、年份和日期时间范围 ​

原生范围选择提交两个端点；清空输出由 emptyValues/valueOnClear 决定，不统一转换为 null。不同 type 使用相应 valueFormat；defaultTime 只设置缺省时刻，disabledDate 用于日期限制，业务起止校验仍由调用方负责。

ASAM 扩展与迁移 ​

2.14.7 新增 quarter、quarters、quarterrange，季度展示可用 YYYY [年第] Q [季度]，模型可用 YYYY-[Q]Q。 完整说明。

ASAM 四档 size 与表单、ConfigProvider 继承一致。 完整说明。

API 阅读方式 ​

下方 Props、Events、Slots、Exposes 按当前实际公开类型与运行默认值生成。组合属性按分支生效，不能任意混搭值模式。标为“未知 / 未声明”的默认值不代表 false 或空值。源码区域提供对应语言的独立 Demo.vue，可直接复制或下载；本地辅助组件、数据和素材已内联到当前文件。

固定 2.14.7 完整用法 ​

下面以 ASAM 公开组件和图标入口承接固定 2.14.7 完整用途，保留 TS/JS 完整示例。基础入口使用原生默认值，未指定 valueFormat 的日期/时间选择保持 Date 模型。

选择日期 ​

选择日期

展开源码
许可
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-root-layout">
		<AsamRadioGroup
			:model-value="size"
			v-bind="{ 'aria-label': 'size control' }"
			class="mb-4"
			@update:model-value="updatesize"
		>
			<AsamRadioButton value="large">large</AsamRadioButton>
			<AsamRadioButton value="default">default</AsamRadioButton>
			<AsamRadioButton value="small">small</AsamRadioButton>
		</AsamRadioGroup>
		<div class="demo-date-picker demo-layout-1">
			<div class="block">
				<span class="demonstration">默认</span>
				<AsamDatePicker
					v-model="value1"
					value-format=""
					type="date"
					placeholder="选择日期"
					:size="size"
				/>
			</div>
			<div class="block">
				<span class="demonstration">带快捷选项的选择器</span>
				<AsamDatePicker
					v-model="value2"
					value-format=""
					type="date"
					placeholder="选择日期"
					:disabled-date="disabledDate"
					:shortcuts="shortcuts"
					:size="size"
				/>
			</div>
		</div>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamRadioGroup, AsamRadioButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatepickerenterdateExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const size = ref<'default' | 'large' | 'small'>('default');

const value1 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const value2 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');

const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: 'Today',
		value: new Date()
	},
	{
		text: 'Yesterday',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setTime(date.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24);
			return date;
		}
	},
	{
		text: '一周前',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setTime(date.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24 * 7);
			return date;
		}
	}
];

const disabledDate = (time: Date) => {
	return time.getTime() > Date.now();
};
function updatesize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'large' || value === 'default' || value === 'small') size.value = value;
}
</script>

<script setup>
import { AsamRadioGroup, AsamRadioButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatepickerenterdateExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
const size = ref('default');
const value1 = ref('');
const value2 = ref('');
const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: 'Today',
		value: new Date()
	},
	{
		text: 'Yesterday',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setTime(date.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24);
			return date;
		}
	},
	{
		text: '一周前',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setTime(date.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24 * 7);
			return date;
		}
	}
];
const disabledDate = (time) => {
	return time.getTime() > Date.now();
};
function updatesize(value) {
	if (value === 'large' || value === 'default' || value === 'small') size.value = value;
}
</script>

import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamRadioGroup, AsamRadioButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';

			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setTime(start.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24 * 7);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: '最近一个月',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setTime(start.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24 * 30);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: 'Last 3 months',

			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setTime(start.getTime() - 3600 * 1000 * 24 * 90);
			return [start, end];
		}
	}
];
function updatesize(value: unknown) {
	if (value === 'large' || value === 'default' || value === 'small') size.value = value;
}

	<div class="demo-date-picker demo-layout-1">
		<div class="block">
			<span class="demonstration">默认</span>
			<AsamDatePicker
				v-model="value1"
				value-format=""
				type="monthrange"
				range-separator="To"
				start-placeholder="Start month"
				end-placeholder="End month"
			/>
		</div>
		<div class="block">
			<span class="demonstration">带快捷选项</span>
			<AsamDatePicker
				v-model="value2"
				value-format=""
				type="monthrange"
				unlink-panels
				range-separator="To"
				start-placeholder="Start month"
				end-placeholder="End month"
				:shortcuts="shortcuts"
			/>
		</div>
	</div>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatepickermonthrangeExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const value1 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const value2 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');

const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: '本月',
		value: [new Date(), new Date()]
	},
	{
		text: '今年',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date(new Date().getFullYear(), 0);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: 'Last 6 months',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatepickerquarterrangeExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const value1 = ref<AsamDateValue>();
const value2 = ref<AsamDateValue>();

const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: '本季度',
		value: () => {
			const now = new Date();
			const quarter = Math.floor(now.getMonth() / 3);
			const start = new Date(now.getFullYear(), quarter * 3, 1);
			return [start, now];
		}
	},
	{
		text: 'Last 4 quarters',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setMonth(start.getMonth() - 12);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: 'Next 8 quarters',
		value: () => {
			const start = new Date();
			const end = new Date();
			end.setMonth(end.getMonth() + 24);
			return [start, end];
		}
	}
];
</script>

自定义内容 ​

自定义内容

展开源码
许可
vue
<template>
	<div class="demo-date-picker">
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="value"
			type="date"
			placeholder="选择日期"
			format="YYYY/MM/DD"
			value-format="YYYY-MM-DD"
		>
			<template #default="cell">
				<div class="cell" :class="{ current: cell.isCurrent }">
					<span class="text">{{ cell.text }}</span>
					<span v-if="isHoliday(cell)" class="holiday" />
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="month"
			value-format=""
			type="month"
			placeholder="选择月份"
		>
			<template #default="cell">
				<div class="el-date-table-cell" :class="{ current: cell.isCurrent }">
					<span class="el-date-table-cell__text">{{ (cell.text ?? 0) + 1 }}期</span>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="year"
			value-format=""
			type="year"
			placeholder="选择年份"
		>
			<template #default="cell">
				<div class="el-date-table-cell" :class="{ current: cell.isCurrent }">
					<span class="el-date-table-cell__text">{{ (cell.text ?? 0) + 1 }}y</span>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="quarter"
			value-format=""
			type="quarter"
			placeholder="选择季度"
		>
			<template #default="cell">
				<div class="el-date-table-cell" :class="{ current: cell.isCurrent }">
					<span class="el-date-table-cell__text">Q{{ +(cell.text ?? 0) + 1 }}</span>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDatePickerSlots } from '@asam-ui/ui';
type DateCell = Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDatePickerSlots['default']>>[0];
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatepickercustomcontentExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const value = ref<AsamDateValue>('2021-10-29');
const month = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const year = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const quarter = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const holidays = [
	'2021-10-01',
	'2021-10-02',
	'2021-10-03',
	'2021-10-04',
	'2021-10-05',
	'2021-10-06',
	'2021-10-07'
];

const isHoliday = ({ dayjs }: DateCell) => {
	return dayjs ? holidays.includes(dayjs.format('YYYY-MM-DD')) : false;
};
</script>

<style scoped>
/* stylelint-disable selector-pseudo-class-no-unknown, selector-class-pattern, no-descending-specificity -- Vue deep/native BEM selectors and equivalent media selector groups retained from the fixed official example. */

	gap: 1rem;

.demo-date-picker > * {

}

.cell {
	height: 30px;

	box-sizing: border-box;
}

.cell .text {
	width: 24px;
	height: 24px;
	display: block;
	margin: 0 auto;
	line-height: 24px;
	position: absolute;
	left: 50%;
	transform: translateX(-50%);
	border-radius: 50%;
}

.cell.current .text {
	background: #626aef;
	color: #fff;
}

.cell .holiday {
	position: absolute;
	width: 6px;
	height: 6px;
	background: var(--el-color-danger);
	border-radius: 50%;
	bottom: 0;
	left: 50%;
	transform: translateX(-50%);
}

@media screen and (width <= 768px) {
	.demo-date-picker {
		gap: 1.5rem;
	}
}
</style>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatetimepickerdateandtimeExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const value1 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const value2 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const value3 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');
const defaultTime = new Date(2000, 1, 1, 12, 0, 0);

const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: 'Today',
		value: new Date()
	},
	{
		text: 'Yesterday',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setDate(date.getDate() - 1);
			return date;
		}
	},
	{
		text: '一周前',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setDate(date.getDate() - 7);
			return date;
		}
	}
];
</script>

			const date = new Date();
			date.setDate(date.getDate() - 1);
			return date;
		}
	},
	{
		text: '一周前',
		value: () => {
			const date = new Date();
			date.setDate(date.getDate() - 7);
			return date;
		}
	}
];

<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerofficialdatetimepickerdateandtimerangeExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';

const value1 = ref<AsamDateValue>([new Date(2000, 10, 10, 10, 10), new Date(2000, 10, 11, 10, 10)]);
const value2 = ref<AsamDateValue>('');

const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: '最近一周',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setDate(start.getDate() - 7);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: '最近一个月',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setMonth(start.getMonth() - 1);
			return [start, end];
		}
	},
	{
		text: 'Last 3 months',
		value: () => {
			const end = new Date();
			const start = new Date();
			start.setMonth(start.getMonth() - 3);
			return [start, end];
		}
	}
];
</script>

季度、回填与动态跨年约束 ​

季度、回填与动态跨年约束

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<section class="demo-layout-1">
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="quarter"
			type="quarter"
			format="YYYY [年第] Q [季度]"
			value-format="YYYY-[Q]Q"
			:disabled-date="disabledDate"
			:default-value="new Date(2026, 0, 1)"
			:teleported="false"
			@change="events.push('change: ' + $event)"
		/>
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="quarters"
			type="quarters"
			value-format="YYYY-[Q]Q"
			:show-footer="true"
			:show-confirm="true"
		/>
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="range"
			type="quarterrange"
			value-format="YYYY-[Q]Q"
			:single-panel="singlePanel"
			:unlink-panels="true"
			:disabled-date="disabledDate"
			:default-value="[new Date(2026, 0, 1), new Date(2027, 0, 1)]"
		/>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
		 type="default"
			@click="limitYear = limitYear === 2026 ? 2027 : 2026"
		>
			切换禁用年份 {{ limitYear }}
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" @click="singlePanel = !singlePanel"
			>单面板 {{ singlePanel }}</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
		 type="default"
			@click="
				quarter = '2026-Q2';
				quarters = ['2026-Q1', '2026-Q3'];
				range = ['2026-Q4', '2027-Q2'];
			"
		>
			回填跨年季度
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
		 type="default"
			@click="
				quarter = null;
				quarters = null;
				range = null;
			"
		>
			重置为空
		</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ { quarter, quarters, range, events } }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import type { AsamDateValue } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerquartercontractExample' });

import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const quarter = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const quarters = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const range = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const limitYear = ref(2026);
const singlePanel = ref(true);
const events = ref<string[]>([]);
const disabledDate = (date: Date) => date.getFullYear() < limitYear.value;
</script>

<style scoped>

vue
<template>
	<section class="demo-layout-1">
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="quarter"
			type="quarter"
			format="YYYY [年第] Q [季度]"
			value-format="YYYY-[Q]Q"
			:disabled-date="disabledDate"
			:default-value="new Date(2026, 0, 1)"
			:teleported="false"
			@change="events.push('change: ' + $event)"
		/>
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="quarters"
			type="quarters"
			value-format="YYYY-[Q]Q"
			:show-footer="true"
			:show-confirm="true"
		/>
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="range"
			type="quarterrange"
			value-format="YYYY-[Q]Q"
			:single-panel="singlePanel"
			:unlink-panels="true"
			:disabled-date="disabledDate"
			:default-value="[new Date(2026, 0, 1), new Date(2027, 0, 1)]"
		/>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
		 type="default"
			@click="limitYear = limitYear === 2026 ? 2027 : 2026"
		>
			切换禁用年份 {{ limitYear }}
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton native-type="submit" type="default" @click="singlePanel = !singlePanel"
			>单面板 {{ singlePanel }}</AsamButton
		>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
		 type="default"
			@click="
				quarter = '2026-Q2';
				quarters = ['2026-Q1', '2026-Q3'];
				range = ['2026-Q4', '2027-Q2'];
			"
		>
			回填跨年季度
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton
			native-type="submit"
		 type="default"
			@click="
				quarter = null;
				quarters = null;
				range = null;
			"
		>
			重置为空
		</AsamButton>
		<output>{{ { quarter, quarters, range, events } }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerquartercontractExample' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const quarter = ref(null);
const quarters = ref(null);
const range = ref(null);
const limitYear = ref(2026);
const singlePanel = ref(true);
const events = ref([]);
const disabledDate = (date) => date.getFullYear() < limitYear.value;
</script>

<style scoped>
.demo-layout-1 {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

本地化与高级配置 ​

通过 ConfigProvider 在中文和英文之间切换；该例使用明确公开类型配置本入口的高级属性。尺寸、模型、原生范围与两个独立端点的职责仍按前文分支生效。

日期语言和控件文字是两份配置：本例的 locale.ts / locale.js 同时注册 Day.js 的 zh-cn 日期 locale，中文每周从周一开始，英文从周日开始。 完整说明。

固定版本已经创建的日期对象可能保留旧 locale；本示例切换语言时通过 key 重建控件以更新日期语言，输入弹层会关闭，重新打开即可查看新语言。外部完整模型仍由调用方持有。

本地化与高级配置的完整 SFC

公开面板侧栏 ​

sidebar 收到原生 class: string，把它绑定到侧栏根节点可保留布局。 完整说明。

快捷项与自定义侧栏各自渲染一个原生侧栏块；固定版本两块占用同一左侧区域，启用快捷项可能覆盖自定义侧栏内容。示例明确展示此原生组合行为，需要交互的自定义侧栏应关闭快捷项，或把自己的快捷操作放入同一自定义侧栏；ASAM 不额外改变原生几何布局。

公开侧栏与快捷项

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<section class="demo-layout-1">
		<label>
			<!-- Mode choice uses the public finite picker type. -->
			<span>模式</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="mode">
				<AsamOption v-for="item in modes" :key="item" :value="item" :label="item">{{
					item
				}}</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect></label
		>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="singlePanel">范围单面板</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="teleported">挂载到 body</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="withShortcut">快捷项</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamDatePicker
			v-model="value"
			:type="mode"
			:teleported="teleported"
			:single-panel="singlePanel"
			:default-value="new Date(2026, 0, 1)"
			:shortcuts="withShortcut ? shortcuts : []"
			value-format="YYYY-MM-DD"
		>
			<template #sidebar="scope">
				<!-- Apply the public native class to a block sidebar root. -->
				<aside :class="scope.class" v-bind="{ 'data-sidebar-example': '' }">
					<p class="example-paragraph">日期侧栏</p>
					<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reset"
						>清空模型</AsamButton
					>
				</aside></template
			>
			<template #default="cell">
				<!-- Preserve the existing public cell slot. -->
				<span>{{ cell.text }}</span></template
			>
			<template #prev-year><span aria-hidden="true">«</span></template>
			<template #next-year><span aria-hidden="true">»</span></template>
			<template #range-separator>→</template>
		</AsamDatePicker>
		<output>模型 {{ value }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref, watch } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption, AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamDatePicker } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDateValue, AsamDatePickerProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerSidebarExample' });
const value = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const modes: NonNullable<AsamDatePickerProps['type']>[] = [
	'date',
	'datetime',
	'week',
	'month',
	'year',
	'dates',
	'months',
	'years',
	'quarter',
	'quarters',
	'daterange',
	'datetimerange',
	'monthrange',
	'yearrange',
	'quarterrange'
];
const mode = ref<NonNullable<AsamDatePickerProps['type']>>('daterange');
const singlePanel = ref(false);
watch(mode, () => {
	value.value = null;
});
const teleported = ref(true);
const withShortcut = ref(false);
const shortcuts = [
	{
		text: '固定日期',
		value: () =>
			mode.value.endsWith('range')
				? [new Date(2026, 0, 12), new Date(2026, 0, 14)]
				: ['dates', 'months', 'years', 'quarters'].includes(mode.value)
					? [new Date(2026, 0, 12)]
					: new Date(2026, 0, 12)
	}
];
function reset() {
	value.value = null;
}
</script>

原生清空配置与迁移 ​

基础入口仅委托原生公开 props、事件、slots、模型与 expose。未传属性与显式 undefined、null、false 均保持原生语义；不补入空值，不替换清空工厂，不将输出统一为 null。合法 0、false、undefined 或数组工厂输出及原生的事件顺序完整保留，工厂调用受原生校验与计算规则约束。

固定 2.14.7 对某些清空哨兵与格式组合可能产生空显示、格式化异常或诊断；这些属于原生兼容限制，基础包装不接管处理。 完整说明。

原生清空配置与 nullable 模型

展开源码
vue
<template>
	<section class="demo-layout-1">
		<div>
			<span>清空配置</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="mode" aria-label="清空配置">
				<AsamOption value="default" :label="'默认'">默认</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="false" :label="'false'">false</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="factory-false" :label="'函数返回 false'"
					>函数返回 false</AsamOption
				>
				<AsamOption value="undefined" :label="'函数返回 undefined'"
					>函数返回 undefined</AsamOption
				>
				<AsamOption value="array" :label="'函数返回空数组端点'"
					>函数返回空数组端点</AsamOption
				>
				<AsamOption value="zero" :label="'0 为空'">0 为空</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="epoch" :label="'0 为有效时间戳'">0 为有效时间戳</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</div>
		<div>
			<span>配置来源</span>
			<AsamSelect v-model="scope" aria-label="配置来源">
				<AsamOption value="props" :label="'属性'">属性</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="provider" :label="'配置提供器'">配置提供器</AsamOption>
			</AsamSelect>
		</div>
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="range">原生范围</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamConfigProvider v-bind="provider">
			<AsamDatePicker
				:key="scope + ':' + mode + ':' + range"
				v-model="value"
				v-bind="configuration"
				@update:model-value="updates++"
				@change="changes++"
				@clear="onClear"
			/>
		</AsamConfigProvider>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="restore">回填有效值</AsamButton>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="observedCalls = factoryCalls"
			>读取工厂调用次数</AsamButton
		>
		<output>{{ summary }}</output>
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, ref, watch } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamButton,
	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamConfigProvider
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamDateValue, AsamDatePickerProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamDatePickerEmptyValuesExample' });
const mode = ref('default');
const scope = ref('props');
const range = ref(false);
const value = ref<AsamDateValue>(null);
const updates = ref(0);
const changes = ref(0);
const clears = ref(0);
const observedCalls = ref(0);
// Keep the callback counter non-reactive: reading/incrementing a ref inside a native
// computed factory would itself create a dependency and alter callback behavior.
let factoryCalls = 0;
const summary = computed(
	() =>
		'模型 ' +
		JSON.stringify(value.value) +
		'；update ' +
		updates.value +
		'；change ' +
		changes.value +
		'；clear ' +
		clears.value +
		'；工厂 ' +
		observedCalls.value
);
function clearFactory() {
	factoryCalls++;
	return mode.value === 'factory-false'
		? false
		: mode.value === 'array'
			? [null, null]
			: undefined;
}
type EmptyConfiguration = Pick<AsamDatePickerProps, 'emptyValues' | 'valueOnClear'>;
const emptyConfiguration = computed<EmptyConfiguration>(() => ({
	emptyValues:
		mode.value === 'zero'
			? ['', undefined, null, 0]
			: ['', undefined, null, false, [null, null]],
	valueOnClear: ['factory-false', 'undefined', 'array'].includes(mode.value)
		? clearFactory
		: mode.value === 'false'
			? false
			: mode.value === 'zero'
				? 0
				: null
}));
const provider = computed<EmptyConfiguration>(() =>
	scope.value === 'provider' ? emptyConfiguration.value : {}
);
const configuration = computed<AsamDatePickerProps>(() => ({
	type: range.value ? 'datetimerange' : 'datetime',
	format: 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss',
	valueFormat: mode.value === 'epoch' || mode.value === 'zero' ? 'x' : 'YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss',
	...(scope.value === 'props' ? emptyConfiguration.value : {})
}));
function restore() {
	value.value =
		mode.value === 'zero'
			? range.value
				? [86400000, 172800000]
				: 86400000
			: mode.value === 'epoch'
				? range.value
					? [0, 86400000]
					: 0
				: range.value
					? ['2026-01-12 09:30:00', '2026-01-14 17:30:00']
					: '2026-01-12 09:30:00';
}
function onClear() {
	clears.value++;
	observedCalls.value = factoryCalls;
}
watch([mode, scope, range], restore);
restore();
</script>

<style scoped>
.demo-layout-1 {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

弹层 ClassValue 与组合两端 ​

popperClass 支持字符串、对象、嵌套数组与 false/null/undefined。对象中 false 的键不生效；修改类名时已打开弹层同步更新，ASAM 四档尺寸类仍保留。两个独立端点分别承接同一配置。teleported=true 时弹层挂载到 body，自定义弹层样式需使用全局选择器。

弹层 ClassValue 与组合两端

展开源码

				<AsamOption value="array" :label="'嵌套数组'">嵌套数组</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="string" :label="'字符串'">字符串</AsamOption>
				<AsamOption value="false" :label="'false'">false</AsamOption>

				<AsamOption value="undefined" :label="'undefined'">undefined</AsamOption>

		>

			<!-- Change the public configuration without recreating controls. -->

					item

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, ref } from 'vue';
import {
	AsamSelect,
	AsamOption,
	AsamCheckboxItem,
	AsamDatePicker,
	AsamTimePicker,
	AsamDateTimePicker,
	AsamDateTimeRangePicker
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamControlSize,
	AsamDatePickerProps,
	AsamDateValue,
	AsamTimeValue,
	DateTimeRangeValue
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamPickerClassValuesExample' });
const sizes: AsamControlSize[] = ['large', 'big', 'default', 'small'];
const size = ref<AsamControlSize>('big');
const enabled = ref(true);
const teleported = ref(true);
const mode = ref('object');
const date = ref<AsamDateValue>('2026-01-12');
const time = ref<AsamTimeValue>('09:30:00');
const legacy = ref<DateTimeRangeValue>(['2026-01-12 09:30:00', '2026-01-14 17:30:00']);
const range = ref<DateTimeRangeValue>(['2026-01-12 09:30:00', '2026-01-14 17:30:00']);
const popperClass = computed<AsamDatePickerProps['popperClass']>(() => {
	const object = { 'asam-example-popup': enabled.value, 'asam-example-hidden': false };
	if (mode.value === 'object') return object;
	if (mode.value === 'array') return ['asam-example-array', [object, false]];
	if (mode.value === 'string') return enabled.value ? 'asam-example-popup' : '';
	if (mode.value === 'false') return false;
	if (mode.value === 'null') return null;
	return undefined;
});
</script>

原生默认值与适配说明 ​

type 为 date，format 按 type 决定，valueFormat 未设置时为 Date；modelValue 默认空字符串。 完整说明。

局部与全局浮层 ​

基础示例使用默认的全局挂载；局部挂载示例展示显式配置的 teleported 或 appendTo。先打开控件浮层，再观察其所在容器。挂载位置与控件值、请求协议互相独立。

用法与契约补充说明 ​

ASAM 扩展与迁移 ​

2.14.7 新增 quarter、quarters、quarterrange，季度展示可用 YYYY [年第] Q [季度]，模型可用 YYYY-[Q]Q。singlePanel 仅在原生 daterange、monthrange、yearrange、quarterrange、datetimerange 生效；单点 datetime 已是一份日期时间面板，不增加另一个范围入口。季度禁用根据实际日期判断，跨年选择应同时检查两端限制。动态替换 disabledDate 后会重新判断当前面板。showFooter、showConfirm 决定多选的提交流程。

ASAM 扩展与迁移 ​

ASAM 四档 size 与表单、ConfigProvider 继承一致。空模型支持 null，展示 format 不改变存储；日期字符大小写按 valueFormat 规则配置。 validateEvent 控制表单校验触发；teleported 决定弹层挂载位置。 单点日期时间使用 DatePicker type=datetime；两个独立日期时间端点使用 DateTimeRangePicker。

本地化与高级配置 ​

日期语言和控件文字是两份配置：本例的 locale.ts / locale.js 同时注册 Day.js 的 zh-cn 日期 locale，中文每周从周一开始，英文从周日开始。应用需显式安装 dayjs，并保证组件与应用消费同一实例；只切换 Provider 字典不会改变周首日。日期 locale 注册不切换应用的全局默认语言。

公开面板侧栏 ​

sidebar 收到原生 class: string，把它绑定到侧栏根节点可保留布局。单点日期、日期时间、周/月/年/季度及对应多选和五类范围面板使用该侧栏。范围 singlePanel 仍按原有适用 type 生效。 示例保留单元格、导航、范围分隔符插槽；输入弹层可以切换 teleported，本体 Panel 就地渲染。

原生清空配置与迁移 ​

固定 2.14.7 对某些清空哨兵与格式组合可能产生空显示、格式化异常或诊断；这些属于原生兼容限制，基础包装不接管处理。需要 nullable 业务模型的调用方应在自己的高级数据适配层处理；双端 DateTimeRangePicker/DateTimePicker 保留明确的完整范围/null 组合协议。原依赖默认字符串模型的用法需显式传入 valueFormat（日期 YYYY-MM-DD，时间 HH:mm:ss）。

原生默认值与适配说明 ​

type 为 date，format 按 type 决定，valueFormat 未设置时为 Date；modelValue 默认空字符串。 其余行为默认值交由固定版本原生组件解析；显式 undefined、null、false 原样输入，不以包装层默认值覆盖。size 仅负责 ASAM large/big/default/small 四档密度及品牌样式。DatePicker/TimePicker/TimeSelect 的 focus/blur（日期和时间另有 handleOpen/handleClose）直接使用原生公开实例的接收者和返回值；Panel 没有这些输入实例方法。

关联组件

日期时间范围 AsamDateTimeRangePicker时间选项选择器 AsamTimeSelect全局配置 AsamConfigProvider
